name: Bruxie
tagline: The Original Waffle Sandwich — crispy fried chicken, artisan waffles, and handcrafted custard shakes
description: Founded right here in Old Towne Orange in 2010, the original flagship Bruxie revolutionized comfort food by replacing traditional sandwich bread with light, airy, crispy Belgian-style waffles. Located on North Glassell Street directly adjacent to Chapman University, this legendary walk-up stand and shaded outdoor patio serves jumbo hand-breaded fried chicken tenders, savory waffle sandwiches (like The Original with chili honey & cider slaw, and Kickin' Chicken), loaded waffle-cut fries, all-day breakfast burritos, and Wisconsin custard shakes.
historicNote: The historic walk-up stand on North Glassell was originally an old-school neighborhood dairy delivery depot and soda stand before becoming the birthplace of the worldwide waffle sandwich phenomenon in 2010.
